guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
Legends says that this civilian was once called 'Awesome Binglus'.

You are amazing and makes sure everyone knows that with your notes

The copycat is gifted by the God of Train and WyspiaExpress. This gift allows them to freely adapt to any situation. 

 Press E and you can choose a killer role from a selected options

People often wonder what law did The Outlaw break to receive such a name. Rumours says that he just thinks its cool to be called "The Outlaw" so he gave himself that name, just like how his friend Michael named himself "The Maverick".

 They spawn and can purchase an Outlaw Revolver, which doesn't drop when shooting an innocent. They could also instantly recharge the Revolver with their ability
guidebook.role.wyspiaexpress:edge_lord: The Edgelord Delusional Cursed Assassin of Darkness and Coffee Addiction
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress: The Edgelord Delusional Cursed Assassin of Darkness and Coffee Addiction has keen vision even in the deepest shadows ",I was born in the dark", this alongside the Assassin's reduced cost blackout allows them to truly be a master of shadows. Just dont forget a coffee break between lapses of your curse and its darker impulses. Lastly be careful not to cut yourself on your own edge.
guidebook.role.title.wyspiaexpress:gambl: The One Who Never Lost a Bet
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress: They're no stranger to chance, but their chance has gone to another level. Their mastery of luck manipulation leads them to a game of roulette that they must survive. They can get a random item from a mystery box.

The Lich has been practicing the dark arts for years both in life and in death. They have gained the ability to bring the dead back and manipulate them to do their bidding.\n\nOnce every few minutes, the Lich can interact with a body to bring them back to life as a Fragile Ghoul, a much weaker killer ( you cannot revive a Fragile Ghoul again). 
The Lich themself cannot directly kill any player, so they must rely on their ghouls doing their job.
You get no benefit other than a key called "Employee Key". This key can open some doors
